mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies and a temperature of 55 degrees, feeling like 52 near the Military Ridge State Trail.

In local news, winter alternate-side parking regulations will run from November 20th through April 1st. Also, the Water Utility has partnered with HydroCorp to conduct routine cross-connection control surveys, so watch your mail for scheduling details if your home or business is up for inspection.

Looking at area events, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market today on the Capitol Square or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard. Next week, keep an eye out for local trivia nights at Hop Haus Brewing and Lake Lou-ee on Tuesday.
In police news, on Saturday, officers responded to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue for a vehicle stopped in the road, arresting a 40-year-old Verona man for O W I first offence.
Finally, Culver's is open today until 10:30 PM, featuring Mint Explosion as the flavor of the day, with Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough on deck for tomorrow.
